theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_fpm_exists_local_place
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → (∀ f : F, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, b ≠ 0 ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b)
theorems.natural_summary: Uses accepted fraction-subalgebra, integer-order, and principal-ideal dependencies to construct the place with the prescribed membership characterization.
